name: Windham Mountain Club

source.note: Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Approximate base-lodge position just south of Windham village off NY-23
Piste reference data (not web-verified in this build) — confirm at source. Commonly advertised figures (base ~1,500 ft, summit ~3,100 ft, vertical ~1,600 ft)

Search summary (2026-09-30; attribution not isolated): 285 skiable acres, 54 trails, 11 lifts including four high-speed detachables (1 six-pack, 3 quads) and 5 surface lifts. Chairlifts = 6 is derived (11 total minus 5 surface lifts); the types of the two other chairs were not stated.

character: A northern Catskills ski area in Windham, NY, now branded Windham Mountain Club with a membership-oriented model. Public day access for 2026-27 should be checked before planning a visit.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the base. Learning-area details and public lesson availability were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Dec 4, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

prices.note: Aggregator (snowstash.com): 2026/27 day tickets from $99, peak $149. The official Double Diamond Pass page lists products from $99 (Adult/Youth/70+); terms not captured. Confirm at source.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-79 to Binghamton, I-88 E to Exit 21 (Harpersfield), then NY-23 E via Stamford, Grand Gorge, Prattsville and Ashland to Windham); not a routing-service result. Two-lane roads for the last ~70 km; winter conditions add time.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY Thruway (I-87) S to Exit 21 (Catskill), then NY-23 W via Cairo and East Windham); not a routing-service result.
